name: Up or down: momentum against reversal
hypothesis: A playbook written by an AI agent calls the direction of live five minute crypto markets more often than a coin flip.

agent_a.hypothesis: Moderate BTC-backed rises keep going and clear falls keep falling, but in five-minute crypto the edge is thin, so the live result will sit near the 52-53% breakeven and is unlikely to clear 95%.
agent_a.value: {"version":1,"kind":"playbook","name":"Measured momentum, broad tape v3","rules":[{"when":[{"signal":"btc_ret_15m","op":">=","value":0.21}],"side":"down","why":"BTC already ran hard over 15m: the chase is spent and the next five minutes give back (44.0% up on 904)."},{"when":[{"signal":"ret_5m","op":">=","value":0.04},{"signal":"ret_5m","op":"<","value":0.15},{"signal":"btc_ret_15m","op":">=","value":-0.04}],"side":"up","why":"Fresh, moderate 5m rise with a calm-to-firm BTC tape: the move is still being worked, not exhausted."},{"when":[{"signal":"ret_15m","op":">=","value":-0.05},{"signal":"ret_15m","op":"<","value":0.26},{"signal":"btc_ret_15m","op":">=","value":-0.04}],"side":"up","why":"Steady 15m drift up with BTC agreeing: broad, orderly buying tends to carry on."},{"when":[{"signal":"ret_5m","op":"<","value":-0.13}],"side":"down","why":"A clear 5m fall keeps falling as sellers work their orders over minutes."}],"otherwise":"up"}

agent_b.hypothesis: Fading stretched Bitcoin rallies and buying last-minute and high-volume dips edges past a coin, but by only 1 to 3 points, likely not enough to clear 95% in 240 markets.
agent_b.value: {"version":1,"kind":"playbook","name":"Fade the stretch, trimmed","rules":[{"when":[{"signal":"ret_5m","op":"<=","value":-0.37},{"signal":"volume_ratio","op":">=","value":1.5}],"side":"up","why":"A sharp 5m drop on a volume burst is forced selling in thin books that snaps back (60% up on 85, a small sample)."},{"when":[{"signal":"btc_ret_15m","op":">=","value":0.21}],"side":"down","why":"A stretched 15m Bitcoin rally lifts every asset on borrowed momentum and gives back once the push fades (44% up on 904)."},{"when":[{"signal":"ret_1m","op":"<","value":-0.06}],"side":"up","why":"A last-minute dip is mostly thin-book noise that gets bought back (54.6% up on 868)."},{"when":[{"signal":"ret_15m","op":">=","value":-0.05},{"signal":"ret_15m","op":"<","value":0.26}],"side":"up","why":"An unstretched 15m tape has no overshoot to unwind, so the drift holds (mid ret_15m bands about 55% up)."},{"when":[{"signal":"volume_ratio","op":"<","value":0.67}],"side":"up","why":"Quiet volume means no pressure to unwind, so the drift holds (about 54% up below 0.67)."}],"otherwise":"down"}
